name: Skrimp
bio: Falling down a ravine and taking several bumps on the noggin changed Skrimp's life forever. Those repeated knocks broke Malice's spell on him – now, he fights for justice! For Serenity! Unfortunately, it also gave Skrimp unbreakable confidence, and the unshakeable conviction that he's the greatest hero that's ever heroed. Thank Serenity's he's on our side.
